---
title: inif.converters.evaleval
description: Convert every_eval_ever instance-level records into INIF documents.
reference: inif.converters.evaleval
---

Targets the `instance_level_eval_0.2.2` schema used by the
[`evaleval/EEE_datastore`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/evaleval/EEE_datastore)
HuggingFace dataset. The HF entry point requires the `evaleval` extra
(`pip install "inif[evaleval]"`); local JSON / JSONL conversion does not.
See [the evaleval converter guide](../converters/evaleval.qmd) for the
field-mapping table, scoring, and metadata promotion rules.

## Entry points

### from_instance_records

### from_eval_json

### from_hf_dataset
